title: I got sidetracked and built 40 Game worlds
author: troveofvisuals
selftext:
Hi everyone!

so a bit of context, whilst testing out my other product that I've been building, I ended up creating 3D game worlds/ environments. these could be used in RPG, open world, FPS, and even strategy games.

I think alot of us get way too bogged down with the art direction side and then end up giving up altogether or sacrificing on story and gameplay.  So I decided to put them up for grabs at a nominal value cost.

There's 40 hi detailed 3D game environments are available in .ply and .spz formats. These are GAUSSIAN SPLATS and can be used in Blender, Unity, Unreal, three js, (double check if your version supports .ply and.spz).  
  
Got a variety of environments with some quirky ones and different aesthetics as well. And yes popcorn can be available on Mars.

Build whatever you want (show me if you do please)

Link to site in comments

comments.author: Eskibro830
comments.body: Looks cool. Are you interested in sharing your process for making these? If not, fine, more power to ya.

comments.author: Defiant-Code7676
comments.body: Looks amazing, but it seems you can't travel too far, are these panoramics? That would make sense as splats.

replies.author: troveofvisuals
replies.body:
can you please clarify by what you mean as panoramics? like photos? 

These are actual splats, like point cloud splats that you can travel through- but as its typical with gaussian splats- you cant get TOO close. 

you can travel far depending. because some of these worlds would need to be scaled up for real worldish proportions. I wanted to show the entire worlds without taking up time so didnt do that but yes you cant get TOO close to the ends

replies.author: Defiant-Code7676
replies.body: It's ok, I misinterpreted the post as generating splat at every point in world space, so you can move the camera around instead of limited around the center, that would be a tech breakthrough

replies.author: AimDev
replies.body: It gets the views and rage engage pumps the social algo which translates to sales, sadly. That's the world we live in

replies.body: I feel like we need a new level of flair. There's "Commercial Self Promotion" where someone is sharing what they are making, and then there are just plain click-bait money grabs. It's seriously hurting the credibility of this community.

Can you walk more than 10 feet in any direction before the illusion falls apart?

replies.body: You can't travel too far away from the center, they have little use since the enviro is mostly static
